source_snapshot.procedure: Loads amdgpu RAS, queries UMC block0 count on device0, injects GFX block2/type2 on device0, then decodes with `amdgpuras -C -d 0`.
source_snapshot.criteria: Requires injection success, amdgpu hardware-error output and a table6.2-like corrected record with device/BDF/socket/block/subblock plus JSON severity and raw registers.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; broadly calls for injection and decode but adds unrelated fatal/nonfatal, bad-page and XGMI BER checks and omits freshness/schema correlation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly recognizes decode coverage yet is too generic and expands into unrelated RAS categories.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires the whole corrected record and target mapping.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row119 changes device and severity to fatal. Its MCE/type4 fields cannot be accepted for this corrected CMC/type2 case.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Decode validation needs a fresh record tied to one injection, dynamic platform identity and field-level semantic checks; fixed sample timestamp/BDF/record_id are examples, not universal values.

original_test_intent: Inject one approved correctable GFX error on AMD GPU device0, decode the newly created RAS record, and verify corrected severity, target location, notification class and register payload against the applicable AMD GPU RAS guide table6.2.
original_method: Bind device0 to UUID/BDF/OAM/socket, prove block2/type2 semantics, verify ras_enable and tool support, capture a pre-injection decode cursor plus relevant counters/logs, inject once, decode immediately, correlate record freshness and target, validate required schema/fields against the approved guide, then confirm GPU/workload health without repeating the event.
manual_activity: The GPU RAS owner approves the amdgpuras build, table6.2 revision, device0 mapping and one correctable injection; the agent later captures and compares the fresh decoded record under a separate execution gate.
required_inputs: Approved amdgpuras build/version/checksum and AMD GPU RAS Tool guide table6.2 revision
GPU UUID/BDF/OAM/socket-to-device0 map and proof block2/type2 is the intended GFX correctable stimulus
Driver/firmware/kernel/OS support matrix and current ras_enable state
Required decoded schema, allowed dynamic fields and expected corrected/CMC/block/subblock/register semantics
Preexisting record/counter handling, freshness cursor and duplicate-record policy
Dedicated-SUT approval, idle workload state, console/OOB recovery and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated idle accelerator and stable UUID/BDF mapping with independent recovery
Do not unload/reload amdgpu to apply ras_enable without owner approval and multi-GPU impact review
Preserve preexisting logs/records; establish freshness without indiscriminate clearing
Run block2/type2/device0 once and abort on target mismatch, wrong severity, reset, XID, hang or incomplete decode
Do not repeat automatically; preserve raw JSON/text and recover/verify GPU health before any clear
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool, guide, device/block/type mapping, ras_enable, existing records and recovery readiness
After separate approval, capture exact injection and full decode output plus correlated logs
Do not assume GPU index stability, clear records/logs, modify driver state, inject repeatedly, reset/reboot, recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve tool/guide revision, target tuple and decoded-field oracle
Approve how to distinguish a fresh record from existing records
Supervise single injection and any recovery
Evaluate field comparison and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Directionally correct but omits the source's block2/type2/device0 commands and adds unrelated bad-page/XGMI/fatal categories.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After validation and approval, run the literal block2/type2/device0 injection once followed immediately by full `-C -d 0` decode and target/freshness-aware field comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: modprobe ras_enable=1, UMC query, block2/type2/device0 injection, device0 decode, table6.2 reference, source sample record and 30/30-minute scope remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create one corrected GFX event and validate a newly correlated decode record field by field against the approved guide and dynamic target identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds pre-decode freshness, stable UUID/BDF mapping, separates irrelevant UMC baseline from GFX evidence and defines dynamic-versus-semantic fields.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Injection success and a syntactically valid JSON object do not prove the decoded record is new, belongs to device0 or represents the injected GFX correctable event.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Record ordering and identifiers may be dynamic; driver resets can erase or reorder evidence and affect active accelerators.

project_override_considerations: Treat the sample BDF 0000:0c:00.0, socket2, OAM2, timestamp and record_id as platform-run evidence, not constants, unless the current recipe explicitly fixes them. UMC block0 baseline is contextual only for a GFX block2 decode case.
expected_evidence: Tool and guide provenance plus UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/device0 and block2/type2 mapping
Driver/firmware/kernel/OS, ras_enable, idle status, preexisting decoded-record cursor and relevant counters/logs
Exact one-shot injection transcript and timestamped fresh dmesg/RAS evidence
Complete `amdgpuras -C -d 0` raw output parsed without dropping unknown fields
Fresh target-correlated Corrected severity, CMC notification, GFX block/subblock and table6.2-compatible raw registers with allowed dynamic fields explained
Post-GPU/workload health, recovery/restoration record and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The GFX correctable injection and decode criteria are coherent. The UMC baseline is weak contextual evidence, but it does not contradict the stated GFX target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose, commands and guide-based acceptance are identifiable. Package, guide, target mapping and execution approval are normal gated inputs.

review_improvement: Adds record freshness and dynamic identity semantics, rejects unrelated DeepSeek coverage and prevents the UMC baseline from being mistaken for the GFX decode oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: A decoder can successfully return an old record, so syntactic output alone is insufficient. The new record must be correlated by time/sequence and target identity to the one block2/type2 injection, while severity and architectural fields match table6.2. The fixed sample values cannot be universal on a multi-GPU platform.
